usageNotes: Renews the ACME (Let's Encrypt) TLS certificate on a PDM node; by default only proceeds if the certificate expires within 30 days, so pass force=true to renew immediately regardless of expiry. The call returns a UPID — poll the task log with the tasks API to confirm success before relying on the new certificate. Requires System.Modify on the node and a working ACME account/domain config already in place.

examples.summary: Force-renew the ACME certificate on node 'pdm1' immediately

tips: Without force=true, the API is a no-op if the certificate has more than 30 days remaining — check the returned UPID task log to confirm whether renewal actually ran.
ACME account and domain must be configured on the node before calling this endpoint; use the ACME account/plugin APIs to set those up first.
API tokens are permitted (allowtoken: true), making this safe to call from automation scripts without interactive credentials.
After renewal, services using the PDM TLS certificate (web UI, API) will pick up the new cert on the next connection — no manual service restart required.
